scope: Entry-level breadboard mounting descriptors; all published component definitions, default artwork and native assets remain unchanged.

host.selection: Main terminal-strip holes only; power rails excluded. Each group is the first contact ID of an existing internal conductor.

installation: Guest descriptors assume straight 2.54 mm male headers installed with insertion leads below the PCB. They do not claim compatibility for unsoldered, female-header, right-angle or castellated-SMT-only assemblies.
rejectedForThisRelease: Unreviewed boards and generic native wire carriers
SMT/castellated land centers that differ from insertion-hole centers
XIAO and Teensy carriers without a reviewed insertion-contact map

sources.nano: Manufacturer datasheet mechanical pages: 11 (A000005), 9 (ABX00028), 17 (ABX00083), 16 (ABX00053), and 17–18 (ABX00142). The Nano family hardware guide confirms the 2.54 mm header pitch.
sources.pico: Manufacturer product-brief physical specifications show 2.54 mm pitch and 17.78 mm header span. The component-side view has USB above.
sources.feather: Manufacturer downloads provide the exact board schematic and fab print. The official Feather specification confirms 16 + 12 contacts and 20.32 mm row spacing. The shorter row has a 10.16 mm longitudinal offset.
sources.espressif: The named manufacturer mechanical PDFs were independently reviewed for pitch and row span. The ESP32-S3 V1 board is 25.40 mm wide with 1.27 mm edge offsets, giving 22.86 mm header spacing. Auxiliary measurement jumpers are omitted.

entries.note: Install straight 2.54 mm male headers with the long insertion leads below the PCB. Only the listed header leads enter the breadboard; auxiliary sockets, solder pads and programming contacts remain separate. Component side, antenna above. J1 and J3 each have 22 leads; their rows are 22.86 mm apart.
